title: Who lasts 365 days?
format: Experiment/contest with personified traits + counter + twist

beats.text: Four people make the same promise. Work out every single day for a year.
Only one makes it. And it's not the one you're betting on.
Habit has the weakest battery of them all.
Day 12. It's raining. Motivation stays in bed.
Day 39. Talent quits. Not because it's too hard. Because it got boring.
Habit's battery starts charging. All by itself.
Studies suggest it takes about 66 days for effort to turn automatic.
Day 180. Discipline is running on empty.
And right here, Habit takes over.
Motivation gets you started. Discipline gets you through the hard days. But what gets you to the finish line is what you don't have to think about anymore.
Which of the four are you right now?
